exchange_wallet_balance_observation.capture_method: Rendered public webpage observation; original page bytes and response headers not preserved.
exchange_wallet_balance_observation.methodology: Daily balances read from XRPL through rippled account_info; exchange attribution uses XRPSCAN public labels. Same-wallet deltas exclude wallets newly added to the tracked set.
limitations: Includes cold storage and exchange-controlled wrapped-asset backing reserves; not tradable float or customer deposits alone.
Same-wallet decreases cannot distinguish customer withdrawals from internal exchange rebalancing or transfers to currently unlabeled wallets.
Naive aggregate change is distorted by two newly tracked wallets holding 512.0M XRP.
The publisher is one derived aggregator; the individual wallet list and raw ledger responses were not captured in this run.

etf_flow_observation.universe: Six US spot XRP ETFs plus the XRP sleeve of BITW
etf_flow_observation.underlying_holdings_source: Each fund issuer's published holdings page, as described by the aggregator.
etf_flow_observation.flow_method: Day-over-day change in issuer-reported XRP holdings; not a direct transfer-agent or authorized-participant creation/redemption feed.
limitations: Funds with flow-excluded observations contribute zero to the aggregate, so this is not a complete all-fund flow reconciliation.
Reconstructed daily rows are estimates between issuer-reported anchor days.
Holdings changes may include fees and other adjustments and are not automatically equivalent to net primary-market cash creations/redemptions.
The capture is one aggregator page; issuer pages were not independently retrieved in this run.

forecast_reason: No synchronized point-in-time history, independently captured raw receipts, validated source independence or out-of-sample predictive lift was established by these observations.
